sentences.text: The smallest species, A. wimani, measured roughly the size of a gentoo penguin.
Its humerus was very slender, falling between ordinary bird wings and the thickened wings of modern penguins.
The genus Notodyptes is a synonym of Archaeospheniscus.
This animal lived from 41.03 to 23.04 million years ago.
Scientists debate whether Archaeospheniscus is an ancestor of modern penguins or represents a case of parallel evolution.
